<EvidenceFact>
  <EvidenceAnchor id="fact-c40912-board-p-q5-role" />

  **Fact:** `fact-c40912-board-p-q5-role`

  **Value:** Board P Q5 (phase-7 draft): gate and source on Q1\_MX, drain on Q1\_G; only the body diode (anode Q1\_MX, cathode Q1\_G) is used, as the one-way element of the Q1 Miller soft-start network · **Unit:** `NONE`

  **Conditions:** Body-diode forward voltage and reverse leakage are not in this bundle (UNSOURCED); the reverse voltage is at most the Q1 gate-source span, below the 50 V VDS row. Behaviour unmeasured.

  **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH · **Provenance:** PROJECT-CHOICE

  **Evidence:** [`src-c40912-primary`](#src-c40912-primary) — board\_p\_spec.py COMPONENTS Q5 row and NETS rows Q1\_MX, Q1\_G
</EvidenceFact>

<EvidenceFact>
  <EvidenceAnchor id="fact-c40912-board-p-q6-role" />

  **Fact:** `fact-c40912-board-p-q6-role`

  **Value:** Board P Q6 (phase-9 draft, dec-p-stusb-local-clamp): VBUS\_EN\_SNK cascode with source on VBEN\_PIN (U1.16, D11 clamp), drain on VBEN (R12 to the Q1 gate network) and gate on VG\_LOC = VDD\_LOC / 2 (R31/R32 100k); the open-drain pin cannot rise above the gate, so it stays at or below about 10.5 V · **Unit:** `NONE`

  **Conditions:** VGS stays below the 20 V row (at most 10.50 V with VDD\_LOC at its 20.794 V surge-row bound and 1 % divider resistors); the minimum gate drive at a 5 V attach (2.165 V at the idle IDD maximum, 2.083 V at twice the idle typical) exceeds the 1.5 V VGS(th) maximum row (VDS = VGS, 250 uA, 25 C only). RDS(on) at that drive and off-state leakage at temperature, which set the asserted VBEN level and Q1 off-state integrity, are not in this bundle (UNSOURCED). Behaviour unmeasured.

  **Verdict:** NEEDS BENCH · **Provenance:** PROJECT-CHOICE

  **Evidence:** [`src-c40912-primary`](#src-c40912-primary) — board\_p\_spec.py COMPONENTS Q6 row and NETS rows VBEN\_PIN, VBEN, VG\_LOC
</EvidenceFact>
